dish.title: Korean Braised Mackerel with Radish (Godeungeo Jorim)
dish.description: Mackerel fillets braised on a bed of thick radish slices in a spicy, savory sauce of gochugaru, gochujang, soy sauce, garlic, and ginger until the radish turns tender and translucent and soaks up the sauce. Served with short-grain rice.

recipe_version.title: Korean Braised Mackerel with Radish (Godeungeo Jorim)
recipe_version.description: Mackerel fillets braised on a bed of thick radish slices in a spicy, savory sauce of gochugaru, gochujang, soy sauce, garlic, and ginger until the radish turns tender and translucent and soaks up the sauce. Served with short-grain rice.

ingredients.name: gochujang
ingredients.display_name: gochujang whose label lists no barley malt or shellfish

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Rinse the rice. Peel the radish and cut into 1/2-inch half-moons. Slice the onion and jalapeño, cut the scallions, mince the garlic, and grate the ginger. Halve the fillets. Stir the garlic, ginger, gochugaru, gochujang, soy sauce, and sugar into a sauce.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice and 2 cups water in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high heat, cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes; then rest covered off the heat 10 minutes. This runs inside steps 3 to 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Par-cook the radish
steps.body: Lay the radish in a 12-inch braiser, add 1 1/2 cups water and half the sauce, bring to a boil over medium-high, cover, and simmer over medium until the radish starts to soften, about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Braise the fish
steps.body: Lay the mackerel skin side up on the radish, scatter the onion and jalapeño, and spoon the rest of the sauce over the fish. Cover and simmer 8 minutes, basting once.

steps.title: Reduce
steps.body: Uncover, add the scallions, and simmer, basting often, until the sauce reduces to a thick glaze and the fish reads 145 F, about 5 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve the fish and radish with their sauce beside bowls of rice.

equipment: 12-inch braiser or deep skillet with lid
